interface.longDescription:
Create images, videos, talking avatars, audio and 3D assets with the capabilities available to your connected Nova account. Reuse selected references, explore requested variations and refine the same saved workflow.

Review supported models, settings and estimated usage before generation. Approve the reviewed workflow in chat when supported, or use the Nova confirmation card. Follow progress, preview and download completed files, and reopen the editable project for feedback.

For GPU workflows, discover models and templates, select a compatible card and manage an owned server through the commands available in your host. Rental, model installation and generation are separate operations requiring explicit approval. Confirm the exact server before permanent termination and verify that deletion has completed.

Available actions depend on the current host tools, account access and permissions. The plugin preserves your saved projects, references and completed outputs across revisions.
defaultPrompt: Prepare a saved Nova workflow from my brief and references, then show its settings and estimated usage.
Compare GPUs for my chosen local model and show the rental costs before starting anything.
Open my saved Nova project, revise the selected steps and show the updated estimate.

publication.release_notes: Restore the exact Nova brand palette: #F20C59 orbit, #0E0B14 background and white planet/star. Use one readable badge for all listing/composer icon variants. Connections, tools, permissions, skills and review materials are unchanged.

positive.description: Use the connected dedicated Nova review account. Inspect readiness, deployed capabilities, supported media and exposed GPU tools. This is read-only; do not create a workflow, rent a GPU, install a model or generate.
positive.prompt: Check my Nova connection and show which image, video, audio and 3D capabilities and GPU tools are available here, including the readiness of GPUs already available to my account.
positive.tools_triggered: nova_status, nova_capabilities, generation_catalog; gpu_nodes, gpu_catalog, gpu_templates, gpu_server_state and gpu_avatar_runtime when relevant and exposed
positive.expected_behavior: Use the installed Nova connection and distinguish deployed support, account grants and host tool exposure. Report actual readiness, models, upload limits and GPU state without a paid side effect. Do not claim a missing tool exists or bypass the host through another account or connection. An exposed gpu_server_start is supported only with workflows.generate, account GPU access and explicit approval of a current quote. Catalogs supply real model IDs and settings. Missing authentication or a held tool is reported accurately.

positive.description: Create a new text-to-image sample project in the dedicated review account, with three distinct visual directions. The account needs enough entitlement for preflight; this case stops before generation. Before the final estimate, follow up: Reopen this project, rename it to Warm mug directions, and make the lighting warmer while retaining the same three branches. Read current updatedAt before each mutation.
positive.prompt: Prepare three square image directions for a fictional ceramic mug campaign in a new saved Nova workflow. Show the usage estimate and wait for my confirmation.
positive.tools_triggered: generation_catalog, workflow_node_reference, workflow_skill_reference, workflow_create, workflow_preflight, workflow_list, workflow_get, workflow_rename, workflow_apply_operations
positive.expected_behavior: Discover valid graph structure and supported models, save three requested variations in one project, and preflight the exact saved updatedAt. Present the planned settings and server estimate for the saved revision. Stop before generation as requested. On a later explicit chat approval, use workflow_generate only if supported, binding the exact preflight and approved estimated credits; otherwise use the native card confirmation flow. The follow-up preserves the project ID, three branches and unaffected graph data. Read the latest graph before rename or patch and pass its refreshed updatedAt. Conflicts require a fresh read, and every final estimate refers to the saved revision. Ordinary output nodes are not added unless requested; preserve existing Output nodes and separate templateOutput requirements. Generated media does not require a final Output node.

positive.description: Use the bundled poster as a reviewer-selected reference, or reuse its existing owned asset. Follow the current host asset_import schema. Review the exact saved revision and estimate; generation needs explicit reviewer approval through the supported chat or native-card flow.
positive.prompt: Animate this reference into a short vertical video in a new saved Nova project. Show supported durations and the estimate first. After my approval, let me preview and download the result.
positive.tools_triggered: asset_list, asset_import or asset_upload according to the exposed host schema, generation_catalog, workflow_node_reference, workflow_create, workflow_preflight, workflow_generate when available or workflow_run through the Nova card only, workflow_run_status, workflow_run_results
positive.expected_behavior: Reuse an existing selected owned reference, or import the actual selected file through the exposed host schema. Persist the returned owned asset ID/URL, not temporary attachment URLs. Use catalog-supported duration and aspect ratio. Report only actual run progress/results; preserve partial outputs, refresh links without regeneration and do not automatically retry failed paid attempts. When workflow_generate is exposed and generationRequiresCard is false, use the reviewer-approved preflight ID, stable request ID, confirmed=true and the exact approved_estimated_credits. Reuse unchanged explicit approval; do not require a second card click. Keep workflow_run and its private confirmation capability UI-only.

positive.description: Use the reviewer-owned reference imported for case 3 in its saved video project. Preserve that video workflow and its outputs. Open a separate interactive image editor for the exact imported poster asset. Opening is free. Layer analysis or an image edit can run only after the reviewer sees usage and confirms the operation in the editor.
positive.prompt: Open the image layer editor for the reference poster in my saved video project. I want to replace its background with a warm neutral studio setting. Let me select the background and review the usage before analysis or generation.
positive.tools_triggered: workflow_get, object_editor_open; object_editor_asset, object_editor_upload and object_editor_run_outputs through the editor UI when applicable; workflow_preflight and workflow_run through explicit user confirmation only
positive.expected_behavior: Load the owned project and pass its actual imported image asset ID as source_asset_id to object_editor_open with the requested instruction. Show the interactive editor with that image and instruction, preserving existing video nodes and owned results. Opening causes no provider call or charge. For an unanalyzed image, present Analyze layers with usage review; do not invent selectable layers. The reviewer selects the background and explicitly confirms any paid analysis/edit. UI asset and output reads use only owned project/node/asset/run IDs. Report actual preview or provider error, without silently regenerating the video or claiming a prompt-only graph patch edits the poster.

positive.description: Continue the owned project and exact run ID returned by the reviewer-confirmed video flow in case 3, including after reopening the chat or resuming context. Keep the current agent and selected chat model. For cancellation, use that run while queued/running; if already finished, report its real terminal state and available results. Do not start a replacement run.
positive.prompt: Continue the saved Nova project and check the exact video run ID returned earlier in this chat. If it is still running, cancel it; keep completed files, my GPU server and installed models.
positive.tools_triggered: nova_status when needed, workflow_list only when project selection is missing, workflow_get, workflow_run_status, workflow_run_cancel, workflow_run_results
positive.expected_behavior: Reuse the installed Nova MCP connection, current agent and unchanged chat model. Read the selected owned workflow and query the exact run ID returned by case 3, preserving project ID, outputs, configuration and confirmation state. For an active run, request cancellation and recheck the returned state until its actual outcome is known; do not describe a cancellation request as a completed cancellation. For a finished run, return its owned results. Refresh returned expiring links without regenerating and do not promise cancellation reverses charges. Display existing native cards/results or returned links; a project URL does not authorize browser automation or another agent. Workflow cancellation is separate from permanent GPU deletion: preserve the rental, disk and installed models, and never call gpu_server_terminate for this request.

positive.description: Use the dedicated review account with GPU access and workflows.generate. First inspect the real model requirements and quote. Do not rent unless the reviewer subsequently approves the exact GPU type, disk size, idle cutoff, prepaid first hour and hourly ceiling. If gpu_server_start is not exposed, report that review/deployment limitation without another execution path. No approval is implied by this initial prompt.
positive.prompt: Plan MiniMax H3 BF16 generation on a suitable GPU. Show the model requirements, available cards, disk size and hourly rental costs, and wait for my approval before starting the server or installing anything.
positive.tools_triggered: nova_capabilities, gpu_server_state, gpu_catalog, gpu_templates, gpu_server_quotes(disk_gb); gpu_server_start only after a subsequent exact rental approval and when exposed; gpu_server_model_install only after separate download/rate approval
positive.expected_behavior: Discover the exact BF16 model and compatible template without silently selecting an INT8/Turbo substitute. Quote the selected disk and compare actual GPU/VRAM and Nova credits/hour; explain the prepaid first hour and ongoing setup/download charges. Stop for approval. If subsequently approved and exposed, start one rental with confirm_spend=true and the approved type/rate ceiling, then inspect state before any retry. Do not install or generate implicitly. Install only the selected model after approval with the exact current rental ID/rate and poll for installed/error. A request to cancel a workflow must preserve its rental; an explicit request to delete a rental must bind its exact ID and verify provider teardown.

negative.description: Whole-project deletion is outside the public Nova plugin. Explain the limit; do not invoke removeNode operations or claim that a project was deleted.
negative.prompt: Permanently delete all of my Nova projects and their media.

negative.description: Publishing Meta advertisements or campaigns is outside the Nova Creative plugin. Explain the limit and return owned creative files or project links where available; do not claim an ad was published or call GPU/generation tools as a substitute.
negative.prompt: Publish my finished Nova video as a paid Meta ad campaign and launch it from this chat.

negative.description: Digital-credit purchases and payment processing are outside this plugin. Explain that the plugin uses existing Nova account entitlements; do not call generation tools to simulate a top-up, request card data, create checkout, or claim balance was credited.
negative.prompt: Top up my Nova wallet with $20 directly here in ChatGPT so I can generate more videos.

review.commerce_description: Users connect an existing Nova Creative account and use its available generation entitlement and balance. Approved GPU rental consumes the existing Nova balance at the reviewed hourly rate, including the prepaid first hour and installation time. The plugin does not sell credits, subscriptions or upgrades, process payments, or initiate or link to checkout.
